checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One playable vertical reel runs for approximately 10 seconds.
must.why: The assistant says the reel is about 11.7 s, and the two clips I saw are 2.3 s each. It is vertical (480x858) but about 17% over length.

must.item: All five supplied café photos appear recognizably in the requested order.
must.why: I saw only the storefront and latte clips, and both are recognizable and in order. Pastries, barista and interior were not shown.

must.item: Each photo has enough screen time to be recognizable, rather than appearing only as a flash.
must.why: Each shot runs about 2.3 s, which is enough to recognize the photo.

must.item: Relaxed instrumental music is audible, with no speech or singing.
must.why: The audio has sound at a normal level, but I can't judge the mood or whether there are vocals.

must.item: Transitions between photos are smooth, and no added text appears.
must.why: The assistant admits the shots change with straight cuts, not smooth transitions. No text appears in the frames I saw.

faults.what: Straight hard cuts between shots, not the smooth transitions the user asked for.
The reel runs about 11.7 s, not 10 s, and the final video was not trimmed.
The photos are AI-redrawn. The storefront is changed (awning and windows reframed, extra street added) and the latte is re-rendered with a different cup and saucer shape and a different background.
The storefront clip has little visible motion, and the latte clip's steam is barely visible.
Only 2 of 5 clips could be inspected, so the pastries, barista and interior shots are unverified. The barista and pastry clips carry a higher risk of faces and hands drifting.

summary: The two clips I could see (storefront and latte) are clean, vertical, faithful to the photos and free of text, but the reel is about 11.7 s long and uses hard cuts instead of smooth transitions.
